name: North Al-Arqas Outpost
title: North Al-Arqas Outpost
summary: One of the old starter outposts, destroyed by Martine in The First Strike (acpedia). In the kit: a 28 m four-storey Empyrean tower (0x01002866) with four green ethereal lamps on top, an octagon tower, a cottage, the Life Stone, a burning bonfire and, 76 m south-west on a rise, the crystal cluster of the Destroyed Portal to Bluespire, on yellow desert sand.

site.name: North Al-Arqas Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-al-arqas-905c (outpost Life Stone, 10 m from the anchor).

shots.standingOrder: Stand 34 m west-south-west of the Empyrean tower 5 m above the sand and tilt slowly from its doorway up its stone flanks to the four green ethereal lamps at the top; the camera only turns, keep 9 m from the octagon tower.
shots.notes: Vertical tilt up the Empyrean tower of the outpost from its doorway and benches to the four green ethereal lamps on top, a locked position 34 m WSW of the tower with the afternoon sun behind the lens. shots.standingOrder: Lock off 14 m west of the outpost bonfire with the flames low in frame and the green-lit Empyrean tower rising behind them; keep 1.5 m from the generator post and 3 m from the cottage, chickens may be faded.
